tasks.gr8-photosynthesis-and-respiration-t1: Topic: Photosynthesis and respiration. Cover inputs and outputs, chlorophyll, stored food, oxygen and carbon dioxide exchange, cellular energy release, and the relationship between both processes in ecosystems. Ask Grade 8 learners to compare the processes, interpret simple experiment evidence, and explain why both are essential for life.
tasks.gr8-ecosystems-and-micro-organisms-t1: Topic: Ecosystems and micro-organisms. Cover biotic and abiotic factors, food webs, ecosystem balance, conservation, and key micro-organism groups (bacteria, fungi, viruses) including useful and harmful roles. Ask Grade 8 learners to classify ecosystem components, reason about disruptions, and evaluate human impact scenarios.
